name: Académie des Beaux-Arts de Kinshasa
region: Kinshasa · Democratic Republic of the Congo
subtitle: Historic higher art academy and sculpture garden in Gombe, cradle of modern and contemporary Congolese art.

facts.label: Impact
facts.value: Formed generations of internationally acclaimed Congolese sculptors, painters, and ceramists

parts.text: The premier higher institution of visual arts education and artistic experimentation in Central Africa, situated in a lush campus in the Gombe district of Kinshasa. Founded in 1943 by Belgian sculptor-monk Marc Wallenda, the Academy evolved into the creative intellectual epicenter of modern Congolese art. Its wooded grounds function as an open-air sculpture museum showcasing monumental wood, metal, and ceramic pieces produced by faculty and alumni, training generations of artists who have shaped the dynamic Kinois and international contemporary art scene.

gaps: Comprehensive alumni exhibition archive and digitization of studio archives are ongoing.
